title: Machine-readable holdings and per-scoring fields for lead-rules.json
provenance: Rulings 01 overlays, filtered to the rule ids present in the sample lead-rules.json of the public snapshot.

fields.machine: replaces holding.patterns of the rule; kinds: suit, paired, longer, tip. See src/rules/machine.ts
fields.card: replaces recommendation.card; a string or {IMP, MP}
fields.weight: replaces weight; a number or {IMP, MP}
fields.technical: the rule decides top-vs-low as a technical choice: it overrides the partnership card table and is judged card by card
